title: Bestiary tab: kill-unlocked entries with 3D preview, stats, drops and habitat
player_outcome: The Bestiary shows every creature: '???' until seen, a portrait and habitat once seen, stats and description after a kill, and the full drop list with percentages after enough kills. A rotating 3D model shows the selected creature. Completion % is shown.
design: BestiaryTab (game/UI/GuideBook/BestiaryTab.cs): filters (All/Unlocked/Bosses/Critters/Town, a biome filter from habitat tags) and search, over an ItemList with PortraitIcons (P5-28) lazily loaded. Locked entries show a silhouette or '???'. The header shows Bestiary.Percent.

Details (BestiaryDetails.cs): name, kill count, then by unlock tier. Seen: habitat text from a new Core Gameplay/Guide/Habitat.cs that describes the enemy's SpawnRuleDefs through ConditionDescriber ('Surface Forest at night', 'Dungeon', 'during the Blood Moon'), plus boss summon items (items with a summonBoss behaviour targeting it) and events. Stats: Life/Defense/Damage/Knockback resist/Coins (scaled by world difficulty via NpcSystem.Scale) and Description. Full: drops from DropRates with conditions.

3D preview: BestiaryPreview.cs, a single pooled SubViewportContainer (OwnWorld3D, UpdateMode WhenVisible, TransparentBg, the CharacterPreview lighting setup). The model loads with ResourceLoader.LoadThreadedRequest(AssetPaths.CreatureModel) and a spinner, then CreatureVisual.Create shows it with an idle/walk clip and a turntable. The previous model is freed. Worm bosses show the head model.
Town NPC entries: met via the Journal; show portrait, move-in text and a link to the NPC tab.
Engine commands 'ui bestiary <enemy>'; probe ui.bestiary_unlock (0–3 for the shown entry).
data_changes: optional descriptions for the 29 enemies missing one (the audit counted 200 of 229 with descriptions)
tests: HabitatTests: zombie habitat mentions night and surface; eye_of_cthulhu lists suspicious_looking_eye as its summon
Smoke guide.cmds (after the zombie kill): 'ui bestiary zombie' / 'assert ui.bestiary_unlock >= 2' / 'ui close'
verification: In game: kill a slime → its stats unlock; the preview model loads without a frame spike (threaded) and turns; after 25 kills the drops show %
risks: SubViewport cost on low presets: render at 256 px and pause when hidden; scale by graphics preset (skip MSAA on low).
